real: Qt queued signals and thread pool
Engine request validation and history transitions
mocked: Engine._dependencies before any media extraction or download

official_design_sources.observed: Documented video/audio, quality/output selection, queue, light/dark and explicit errors.
Official screenshots: sidebar/list, per-item folder actions, destination and one primary download action.
Official screenshot: URL input, visible destination/format and queue progress/status.
Documented destination-first setup and classic URL/destination/format/add/download sequence.

design_review_scope: Qualitative review of official public documentation and screenshots. No third-party application code copied; no universal usability ranking or user-study claim.
known_limitations: This recorded execution used Linux Qt offscreen; actual Windows display, launcher and bundled runtime behavior require Windows CI or device testing.
Live YouTube extraction, media downloads, format conversion and playback were not exercised by these GUI integration tests.
Microsoft Defender execution, threat detection and scan results were not exercised.
Native folder picker rendering and assistive technology were not exercised; only chooser results and resulting state were tested.
Preview images use empty temporary fixtures and require visual review; offscreen rendering can differ from Windows fonts and display scaling.
